currentParagraphText: “You do not merely fight me... but the entire tribe that you have made an enemy of,” the Warlord said as his aura also began to increase in intensity.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “You do not merely fight me... but the entire tribe that you have made an enemy of,” the Warlord said as his aura also began to increase in intensity.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: Right then, Jake also felt movements of energy through his sphere. The ghostly fog began to gather in four different places, taking the shape of apes, each wielding a unique weapon. Their entire bodies were ghostly and see-through, but Jake knew that getting hit by those weapons would feel very real, and Identify also confirmed they were real... summoned, but real.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: The Warlord raised a hand as mana began condensing around him. Jake was ready to dodge as he suddenly felt the energy in the atmosphere change. A wave of spirit energy washed over him and the entire jungle a moment later, making it look as if a faint fog covered everything, and his vision turned a slight light blue.
